data.description:
Run `inv repair`, `inv gate`, and `inv restart` in the activity-worker container through `_run_scripted`, as `inv intake` does, with a `--local` flag for the host.

The three tasks in `tasks.py` call `c.run("python -m scripts.<name> ...")` on the host. Without an activated virtual environment that resolves to the system interpreter, which lacks the platform's dependencies and fails with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pydantic_settings'`. With the environment on the path, the host run rewrites Compose service URLs to the published host port, which fails when an operator overlay publishes Postgres on a port that the `*_HOST_PORT` variables do not carry. Inside the platform image the service names resolve and `to_host_url` is inert, which is why `inv intake` works on the same host.

Restarting rebar ticket `ff34-7786-fef6-4252` failed both ways on the host and succeeded with `docker exec agentic-dev-platform-activity-worker-1 python -m scripts.restart ff34-7786-fef6-4252`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `inv repair` runs in the activity-worker container by default and on the host with `--local`, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_tasks.py -k repair_runs_in_the_activity_worker`
- [ ] `inv gate` runs in the activity-worker container by default and on the host with `--local`, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_tasks.py -k gate_runs_in_the_activity_worker`
- [ ] `inv restart` runs in the activity-worker container by default and on the host with `--local`, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_tasks.py -k restart_runs_in_the_activity_worker`

## Testing
Run each acceptance criterion selector on its own. Run `PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" .venv/bin/inv ci` before closing the ticket.
data.title: ADEVX-150: Run inv repair, gate, and restart in the activity-worker container
